name: Nate Landwehr
event: UFC Fight Night: Buckley vs. Malott
summary: 'The Train' (18-8, 5-6 UFC), a former M-1 featherweight champion and pressure brawler who drags opponents into attrition fights. At 38 he is on a three-fight skid, all knockouts, and now moves up to lightweight per UFC.com.

how_they_fight.Striking: Forward-marching volume brawler who wants wild exchanges: landed 121 significant strikes on Darren Elkins and 91 on David Onama. Accuracy is middling (about 44%) and he absorbs more than he lands (about 5.4 per minute). Gets chewed up by calf kicks (Charriere badly damaged his left calf) and caught by clean combinations on the way in.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Opportunistic: back-take submissions of Ludovit Klein (R3) and Austin Lingo (R2), and he controlled Onama for over five minutes with three takedowns. Gets back up quickly when taken down, but Doo Ho Choi crucified him and finished with elbows.
how_they_fight.Defense: Durability is now the story. Stopped six times (five KO/TKO, one submission); the five KOs came in R1 (Herbert Burns, Julian Erosa, Cub Swanson) and R3 (Choi, Charriere). Last three fights: TKO R3 Choi, TKO R3 0:27 Charriere, TKO R1 Swanson, where he was dropped repeatedly.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Slow starter who builds (Rotowire): often loses early exchanges, then ramps the pressure. Wins come in the middle: of 11 finishes, three in R1, six in R2, two in R3; seven decisions, including two five-rounders. His late rounds cut both ways: wins over Klein (R3 sub) and Elkins came late, but Choi and Charriere finished him in R3 after he had been taking damage. Gets hurt badly in R1 by sharp counter-punchers.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Thrives in chaos and takes damage to give it; after a low blow against Charriere he got angry and chased the brawl, then was finished seconds into R3 while a heavy live favorite. Rotowire called his Swanson performance passive and wondered about injury or illness (speculation only).

patterns: Starts slowly, then builds pressure and volume
Most finishes in R2 (6 of 11); R3 finishes are rare (2)
Turns adversity into a brawl, even when ahead
Three straight KO/TKO losses (R3, R3, R1); stopped five times by strikes overall
concerns: Shrinking chin at 38 after three straight knockout losses
Calf-kick and counter vulnerability as he walks forward
Moving up to 155 against a bigger, longer striker (UFC.com lists lightweight; AgentMMA said featherweight)
keys_to_beat: Kick the lead calf early to slow the march
Counter his entries with straight punches and combinations
Stay calm when he tries to turn it into a brawl

news.text: Booked against Mandel Nallo in Edmonton; UFC.com lists the bout at lightweight, a step up from his UFC featherweight career, while AgentMMA reported featherweight.
Stopped by Cub Swanson in R1 (4:06) of Swanson's retirement fight after several knockdowns; Rotowire speculated about injury or illness, with nothing confirmed.
